title: Engenheiro de Dados - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Engenheiro de Dados - Remoto.


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Auxílio creche

- Seguro de vida

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

Conhecimentos:

• Programação;

• Tratamento de Dados.

Linguagens:

• Python;

• PySpark;

• SQL.

Ferramentas:

• Big Data:

• HUE;

• Hive;

• Spark (SparkML);

• NIFI.

Banco de Dados:

• DB2;

• MySQL;

• Oracle;

• Dbeaver (Ferramenta de Consulta).

• Modelagem de Dados (Erwin)

• Versionamento de código (Git)


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description

We are…

A digital sports media group with an innovative approach and fan-first mentality, we're redefining how sports content is consumed and shared.

Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. Whether you are a sports fan or just curious, EMP is the place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.

You Are...

An experienced and driven graphic design professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

﻿

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Graphic Designer. The Graphic Designer will be responsible for creating visual content including graphics, logos, branding materials, and typography designs. You will collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement creative concepts and ensure brand consistency across all platforms. Daily tasks will include brainstorming ideas, executing design projects, and refining designs based on feedback.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Graphic Design and Graphics
  • Experience in Logo Design and Branding
  • Skills in Typography
  • Strong attention to detail and creativity
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Proficiency with design software such as Adobe Creative Suite
  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related field
  • Experience in digital media or marketing is a plus
  • Proficiency in English, spoken and written.

title: PESSOA DESENVOLVEDORA RPA PL - REMOTO
description:
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.


Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.


Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Desenvolver, testar e manter automações de processos utilizando Python e ferramentas RPA (Power Automate e Power Automate Desktop);
  • Implementar integrações entre sistemas (via API REST/SOAP, banco de dados, planilhas, e-mails e aplicações legadas);
  • Criar e manter documentações técnicas dos processos automatizados;
  • Monitorar execuções, tratar exceções e garantir a estabilidade das automações;
  • Colaborar com áreas de negócio e TI para levantar requisitos, acessos e validar entregas;
  • Garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, incluindo controle de versão, logs, tratamento de erros e testes;
  • Contribuir para a evolução da esteira de automação, propondo melhorias de desempenho, arquitetura e padronização;
  • Apoiar a implantação e o agendamento de bots em ambientes de produção e orquestradores;
  • Participar de revisões de código, planejamentos e cerimônias ágeis quando aplicável.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência de 2 a 5 anos com automação de processos (RPA) e desenvolvimento em Python;
  • Domínio de estruturas e bibliotecas Python voltadas a automação: pandas, openpyxl, pyautogui, selenium, requests, entre outras;
  • Vivência com plataformas RPA (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate Desktop, Blue Prism ou similares);
  • Conhecimento de bancos de dados SQL (consultas, inserções, atualizações, criação de tabelas);
  • Capacidade de analisar requisitos de negócio, propor soluções técnicas e trabalhar com autonomia;
  • Boa comunicação e organização para documentação e interação com equipes multidisciplinares.


Desejáveis / Diferenciais

  • Certificações RPA (ex: Microsoft PL-500);
  • Conhecimento em integrações via APIs REST/SOAP;
  • Conhecimento em Arquitetura de Soluções/Software;
  • Experiência com IA, OCR ou automações envolvendo leitura de documentos;
  • Noções de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Familiaridade com Power BI, ETL ou automações relacionadas a dados;
  • Conhecimento de CI/CD e execução de bots em ambiente orquestrado (servidores, VMs ou containers);
  • Perfil proativo, analítico e voltado à melhoria contínua.

Informações adicionais:

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.



Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Operational Specialist
description:
What is Metrobi?

Metrobi is a Techstars-backed startup providing local courier services in 20 major metro areas across the U.S.


About the role

As an operations specialist, you will monitor ongoing delivery routes and communicate with delivery drivers and shippers over the phone and live chat.


Requirements

  • Proficiency in English
  • Being able to work based on the Eastern US time zone (EST)
  • Experience in logistics, courier operations, call center, customer support, or account management

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Desenvolvedor Fullstack Sênior - Foco Java


Requisitos para vaga:

  • Formação de nível superior na área de informática ou pós-graduação em TI com duração mínima de 360 horas;
  • Experiência desempenhando funções de desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando tecnologias JAVA e de 03 (três) anos como Desenvolvedor Sênior.
  • Possuir 1(uma) certificação dentre as listadas abaixo:

SUN Certified Java Programmer (SCJP) ou equivalente, emitido pela Sun Microsystems ou pela Oracle;

Oracle Certified Professional, Java SE 8 Programmer ou equivalente, emitido pela Oracle;

Oracle Certified Professional Java SE 11 Developer ou equivalente, emitido pela Oracle;

Oracle Java SE 17 Developer.

  • Experiência nas seguintes tecnologias e processos:
  • Angular e REST;
  • HTML 5 e CSS;
  • Hibernate;
  • Service-Oriented Architecture – SOA e desenvolvimento de web services;
  • Servidor de aplicações JBoss;
  • Openshift ou Kubernetes;
  • Maven/Jenkins (Geração/Automatização de builds);
  • Sonar (Validação de builds);
  • Controle de versões com GIT
  • Elastic
  • kafka
  • quarkus
  • Desejável Conhecimentos:
  • padrões de projeto (Design Patterns);
  • Openshift/Kubernetes;
  • DevOps/DevSecOps;
  • Test Driven Development – TDD e Behavior Driven Development – BDD.
  • Métricas de qualidade de código;
  • Técnicas para construção de software seguro;
  • Método Ágil Scrum.

title: Enablement Process & Curriculum Operations Manager
description:
Position Enablement Process & Curriculum Operations Manager 

Organization SalesSparx LLC 

Location Latin America, EMEA (Remote) 

Contract Type Full-time 

We Are SalesSparx – This Is What We Do  


SalesSparx, founded in 2015, is a boutique consulting firm on a mission to accelerate healthcare innovation. We help high-growth companies, especially those selling technology and services to health systems, scale smarter and faster. Our focus is go-to-market (GTM) strategy, sales enablement, and training execution. 


We’re not just advisors, we’re builders, operators, and trusted partners to the C-suite. At SalesSparx, you’ll get a front-row seat to how real healthcare business gets done, working directly with CEOs, founders, and executive teams. 


We operate in a high-performance, client-first environment where team members are empowered to take ownership, think strategically, and drive outcomes. Whether you're managing projects, leading accounts, or building internal capabilities, your work will shape the growth trajectory of companies at the forefront of healthcare transformation. 


We value curiosity, accountability, and execution. If you thrive in fast-paced settings, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to accelerate your career alongside a team that’s redefining how healthcare companies go to market, this is the place to do it. 


SalesSparx by the Numbers  

  • Have served over 100 healthcare software, consulting and technology firms 
  • 10K+ hours of sales best practice research 
  • $1B+ client bookings 
  • SVS Process used to manage 50K+ sales opportunities per year 
  • 9.9/10 Client Net Promoter Score 
  • Published Light Your Sales FUSE in 2023, the only Healthcare-focused Sales Acceleration Guide in the industry 


Opportunity  


The Enablement Process & Curriculum Operations Manager leads the operational backbone behind SalesSparx’s internal training systems, documentation structure, and methodology governance. 


This professional maintains the single source of truth for internal processes, training curricula, templates, and onboarding structures. They ensure consultants follow the right learning paths, have access to accurate materials, and that our methodologies (SVS, FUSE GTM, consulting workflows) remain organized, structured, and current. 


This is a hands-on, detail-oriented role focused on execution, documentation discipline, and content operations, in additional to management responsibilities. In the short term this person will develop the content to support our operational process and over time will build up its own team. 


What You’ll Do  

Process Documentation & Knowledge Extraction  

  • Interview team members, shadow workflows, and extract tribal knowledge. 
  • Translate informal processes into clear documentation, SOPs, and structured modules. 
  • Maintain an organized, version-controlled process repository. 
  • Ensure internal methodologies (SVS, FUSE GTM, consulting workflows) are accurately documented and regularly updated. 

Template Governance & Content Maintenance  

  • Own the lifecycle and organization of: SVS materials, Go-to-Market assets and Internal consulting templates 
  • Audit and update templates on a defined cadence. 
  • Enforce consistency, version control, and internal standards for all materials. 
  • Maintain a centralized template library that is easy for consultants to access and navigate. 

Training Curriculum & LMS Development  

  • Convert existing training materials into structured LMS modules. 
  • Build quizzes, assessments, practice exercises, and progress tracking workflows. 
  • Maintain curriculum versions and ensure training content remains aligned to current methodology. 
  • Support training execution logistics (materials prep, assignments, communications). 

Onboarding Coordination  

  • Build a structured onboarding flow for new consultants. 
  • Ensure every new hire follows the correct learning path and completes required modules. 
  • Track onboarding progress and report on readiness or gaps. 
  • Provide execution support to the team members leading training sessions. 

Learning Path Compliance & Monitoring  

  • Track consultant participation in learning paths. 
  • Follow up on incomplete modules and escalate when needed. 
  • Maintain dashboards or tracking sheets for enablement completion. 
  • Ensure training compliance is consistently monitored and documented. 

Who We’re Looking For  


Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Business, Education, Sales, Communications, or related fields. 
  • Master’s degree preferred (Education, Instructional Design, Adult Learning, Curriculum & Instruction, or similar). 


Experience  

  • Experience on training Management Consultants is required.
  • Experience on working in a Management Consulting firm is required
  • 5+ years in roles such as: Training Coordinator, Instructional Design Specialist, Enablement Coordinator, Curriculum Development Assistant, Knowledge Management Specialist, or Process Documentation/PMO Support. 
  • Experience on training Management Consultants is required.  
  • Experience building training materials, documenting processes, and maintaining structured content repositories. 
  • Familiarity with LMS platforms, learning paths, assessments, and completion tracking. 
  • Experience in process-driven, documentation-heavy environments. 
  • No prior healthcare experience required. 


Skills  

  • Fluent written and spoken English. 
  • Capable to work on EST hours. 
  • Strong organizational discipline in a fully remote environment. 
  • Ability to extract insights from SMEs and convert them into structured content. 
  • Comfort building onboarding flows, training assets, and learning materials. 
  • Proficiency with: 
  • Documentation tools (SharePoint, Google Drive, etc.) 
  • LMS or course-authoring tools 
  • Project management tools (Asana) 
  • Basic design/editing platforms (Canva, PowerPoint) 
  • Strong attention to detail, consistency, and version control. 
  • Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion. 

Compensation  

  • Competitive Base Salary  
  • Generous Bonus Package 


How to Apply:  

Interested candidates should submit their resume and a cover letter outlining their qualifications and experience to and . Please add "Enablement Process Application" to the subject line.  

Contact  

SalesSparx LLC  

Johanne Marie Nipaya  

Executive Assistant 

Email:  

SalesSparx is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We enthusiastically welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Pessoa Analista Funcional - Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de um Analista Funcional - Sênior, para trabalhar com um banco que entende as necessidades, inova nas soluções e atende com excelência os seus clientes. Estão em um momento de grande evolução de serviços, com forte entrada em soluções digitais para mercado de câmbio (PF e PJ) e serviços de FX as a Service para fintechs e parceiros do mercado financeiro.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

· Levantamento e análise de requisitos: investigar necessidades dos usuários, definir escopo e documentar requisitos.

· Facilitar a comunicação: atuar como ponte entre áreas de negócio e equipe técnica, garantindo entendimento mútuo.

· Mapeamento de processos: identificar fluxos de trabalho e propor melhorias para otimizar sistemas.

· Documentação funcional: elaborar especificações detalhadas que orientem desenvolvedores e testadores.

· Validação e testes: acompanhar implementação, realizar testes funcionais e validar entregas.

· Gestão de stakeholders: conduzir reuniões, alinhar expectativas e garantir que soluções atendam objetivos estratégicos.


Requisitos e qualificações

· Capacidade analítica: interpretar dados e processos para propor soluções eficazes.

· Comunicação clara: transmitir informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos e vice-versa.

· Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis: Scrum, Kanban ou similares, para facilitar projetos de TI.

· Visão de negócio: compreender objetivos estratégicos da empresa e alinhar soluções tecnológicas.

· Proatividade e organização: antecipar problemas, estruturar demandas e manter documentação atualizada.

· Conhecimento técnico básico: entender conceitos de sistemas, bancos de dados e integrações, mesmo sem ser desenvolvedor.


Diferenciais valorizados no mercado:

· Experiência prévia em consultoria ou projetos de transformação digital.

· Certificações como CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional) ou PO/SM em Scrum.

· Familiaridade com ferramentas de modelagem de processos (ex.: Bizagi, Visio).

title: Executive Assistant & Operations Associate (HubSpot/Apollo Preferred)
description:
(Only resumes in English will be considered)


Location:  Remote (must be able to work Eastern Time, Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET)

Compensation:  Competitive salary with growth opportunities

Start Date:  ASAP


About the Role

We’re one of the fastest-growing proptech companies in the U.S., backed by top-tier VCs and some of the largest landlords and managers in the country.


We’re hiring a Executive Assistant & Operations Associate to keep our revenue engine organized, precise, and moving fast. This role sits at the intersection of sales operations, CRM management, and overall support helping the team run smoother, prep smarter, and close faster.


You’ll support our Sales Directors with everything from HubSpot updates and inbox cleanup to property research, demo prep, and post-event follow-ups. You’ll be the behind-the-scenes force that keeps deals and relationships flowing.


The ideal candidate is a HubSpot pro, an organization master, and someone who loves systems, structure, and clean dashboards. Canva or basic design skills are a big plus.


What You’ll Do

Sales Operations & CRM

  • Maintain CRM hygiene across all deals and pipelines in HubSpot
  • Create follow-ups and tasks from meeting notes to keep deals moving
  • Prepare weekly pipeline reports and monthly sales performance summaries (conversion rates, expansion vs. new logos, etc.)
  • Support with contract preparation, sending, and organization
  • Create and maintain accurate customer accounts within the Cosign portal.

Demo & Meeting Prep

  • Research prospects and properties for personalized sales conversations
  • Build decks and slides for demos
  • Assist with pre- and post-event follow-ups and outreach

Inbox, Calendar & Scheduling

  • Clean up and manage up to 4 sales inboxes weekly
  • Schedule meetings and maintain a sales calendar for QBRs, Expansion, first applicant, property engagement, etc

Sales Enablement & Marketing

  • Update and maintain sales collateral, FAQs, and shared materials
  • Create light Canva designs for decks or visuals
  • Support LinkedIn content coordination and posting
  • Track property-level engagement and follow-ups

Account & Partner Support

  • Conduct strategic account research for new opportunities
  • Track deal follow-ups and ensure nothing slips through the cracks

Who You Are

  • 2+ years of experience in sales operations, CRM management, or executive support
  • HubSpot and/or Apollo expert — comfortable managing pipelines, reports, and automations
  • Ultra-organized with strong attention to detail
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Skilled in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and Canva
  • Proactive, reliable, and fast — you take ownership and anticipate needs
  • Fast learner with a strong interest in using AI tools to optimize and streamline workflows.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a startup or high-growth environment

Need to Have

  • Experience in fast pace high-demanding sales environment
  • Experience at startups, proptech, real estate, or B2B SaaS
  • Strong background in sales/operational support
  • Familiarity with project management tools


What Success Looks Like

  • The Sales teams run with clarity, speed, and zero chaos
  • HubSpot data is accurate, up to date, and ready for action
  • Every demo, event, and partner follow-up feels personal and buttoned up
  • Reports and insights are delivered proactively each week
  • You’re the go-to operator who makes everything — and everyone — run smoother

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:



Descrição do Cargo: Engenheiro de Dados Senior


Personalidade: Pessoa hands on (code), com conhecimento de DataOps e onpremise

Responsabilidades

• Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados para a ingestão, limpeza e transformação de dados.

• Coletar, limpar e transformar dados brutos em formatos utilizáveis para análise.

• Modelar e utilizar bancos de dados relacionais (SQL), e data warehouses.

• Colaborar com analistas de dados para fornecer datasets refinados


Conhecimento Técnico

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de fluxos de dados (Ex: Nifi, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue ETL)

• Conhecimento em Python e SQL

• Conhecimento em modelagem de dados

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de transformação de dados (Ex: dbt, EMR, Databricks)

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines (Ex: Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Degster)

• Proficiência em bancos de dados relacionais (Ex: SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL).

• Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e comunicar-se efetivamente em inglês.

• Capacidade de aprender e seguir padrões de trabalho (Agile)

• Capacidade de identificar problemas e sugerir soluções.


Inglês: Avançado ou Fluente


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Sap Advanced Business Application Programming Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for "SAP ABAP" Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Prototype, design, develop, and maintain Mobile Application Integration Framework and its integration services to support mobile applications such as SAP Service and Asset Manager, SAP Maintenance Assistant, as well as other system-to-system integration scenarios such as S/4HANA and Asset Performance Management solution integration, S/4HANA Disconnected Defense, S/4HANA Last Mile Delivery, S/4HANA and Business Network Asset Collaboration solution integration etc.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of SAP ABAP programming model and development tools in development and testing, such as ABAP OO, ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model, BAPI, BAdI, Open SQL, RDBMS, SAPGUI, ABAP Development Tools for Eclipse, Web Dynpro for ABAP, Fiori Elements, SAP Gateway, OData Service, S/4HANA Private Cloud, S/4HAN Public Cloud, SAP ERP system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, integration feature requirement

Setup and configure necessary S/4HANA system business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), setup necessary test data (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), to support the development and test of integration services.

Collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines when relevant.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with frontend MDK developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend.

Conduct thorough testing, including ABAP unit test to fulfill code coverage requirement, backward compatibility, and prevent performance and feature regression with any new development and enhancement.

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, short dumps, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead ABAP developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: JDE Developer
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


JDE Developer

Position Summary:

The JDE Developer is responsible for designing and implementing JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces programs utilizing the JDE developer toolkit owned by the GTS Corporate Applications team. This position serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) resource for JD Enterprise One (JDE), supporting processes, and implementing improvements. The JDE Developer ensures appropriate controls are in place and integrates data for decision makers and business owners to support IT, Compliance, project, and vendor management activities. The JDE Developer will be focused on the Global Systems Implementation , initially on the LatAm and UK/EMEA regions.


Responsibilities:

JDE Developer responsibilities include:

• Serve as a subject matter expert developer for JD Edwards Enterprise One (JDE) associated with functionality, content, processes, and procedures.

• Gather business requirements and implement a global standard design for the Global Systems Implementation of JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces with other Gallagher applications

• Assist with the design and implementation of operational and system enhancements to ensure production capabilities are both effective and efficient

• Ensure JDE development deliverables are completed on time and bug free

• Based on detailed requirements, analyze business needs, create appropriate functional and technical designs, develop the programs, and perform testing to ensure quality of the deliverables.

• Ensure JDE programs are compliant with IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.


Skills Required:

• Technical experience of JD Edwards Enterprise One 9.1 or higher, including application configuration and development

• Experience with JDE Localization implementations, preferably for LatAm countries

• Strong financial applications, analysis and issue resolution (trouble shooting) skills

• Experience working with fellow team members and third party vendors to integrate with SaaS solutions

• Working "hands-on" knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and project management methodologies

• Financial & Business acumen (working knowledge) and awareness of management and analysis processes

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel

• Excellent organization skills, and verbal and written communication skills

• Experience working in large enterprises with domestic and international locations

• Experience working with off-shore or remote development/support teams

• Advanced in Spanish/Advanced English


Desired:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering or related field

• Technology project support experience

• Understanding of integration with Identity Management solutions

• Moderate level proficiency with Microsoft Visio or Lucid

• Intermediate SQL query skills


Work Traits:

• Demonstrated ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously

• Ability to work at a fast pace and cope with conflicting deadlines

• Proven ability to deliver excellent customer service

• Good analytical and problem solving skills

• Strong attention to detail


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Graphic Designer - Apparel
description:
Company Description

Founded in Los Angeles in 2023, BioBlanks is an end-to-end sustainable manufacturing platform leveraging innovative practices to create custom apparel for modern businesses and creators. It is no secret that "swag" and "merch" has become synonymous with cheap and undesirable clothing to be worn once and never thought of again. We spent the past 3 years building a proprietary process in downtown Los Angeles to create apparel that rivals your favorite luxury brand while ensuring that the garments are kind to the earth. We use traceable organic materials, low-impact dyes, and regenerative manufacturing methods to ensure our customers not only love our merch, but the earth does as well. And the best part? We handle every step from design, sourcing, production, and delivery to make sure our clients can stay focused on what they do best—building a killer brand.


Job Responsibilities

  • Lead design projects from initial concept through final production-ready files, bringing creative ideas to client briefs while ensuring every detail meets our quality standards.
  • Collaborate closely with clients and internal teams to translate their vision into compelling apparel graphics, incorporating feedback throughout the design process.
  • Prepare and finalize all artwork for production, including proper file formats, export settings, and color specifications for print.
  • Maintain organized project documentation in Notion and Google Drive, including technical sheets, status updates, and asset libraries.
  • Contribute to brainstorms and creative sessions with fresh ideas that push beyond conventional approaches to apparel design.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve design workflows, templates, and processes as the company scales.


Hard Skills

  • Proficient in vector and raster-based graphics
  • Experience in traditional illustration (hand-drawing)
  • Proficient in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma, including export settings, preparation for print, and required file formats (required)
  • Proficient in web-based tools such as Notion, Google Drive, and Google Sheets
  • 3+ years experience as a graphic designer (required)
  • 2+ years experience as an apparel designer (preferred)
  • Experience working with clients and managing projects (required)
  • Experience with color separation of artwork for printing (preferred)
  • Experience in a startup, agency, or small company environment (preferred)
  • Proficient English fluency (preferred)
  • Intermediate English fluency (required)


Soft Skills

  • Self-starter who takes initiative without needing to be asked
  • Excited to solve problems creatively and think outside the box
  • Strong team player and contributor to company culture
  • Low ego—open to feedback and willing to adapt
  • Not afraid to make mistakes and sees them as opportunities to improve
  • Obsessed with aesthetics and visual design
  • Highly curious with good taste and references within the creative arts
  • Highly productive with strong organizational skills
  • Clear and responsive communicator
  • Passionate about pursuing excellence in all work
  • Thrives on collaboration and constructive feedback
  • Responsible and reliable
  • Wants to grow with a company long-term and build from the ground up


Compensation & Job Information

  • Full-Time (40 hours weekly)
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Monthly wellness stipend
  • Paid biweekly · Contractor

title: Backend Developer, Python
description:
About Us


We’re a fully-remote company distributed across the Americas with no physical headquarters. We help companies build great products that matter - that's what defines us as a group.


We’re a developer-first software development nearshore company. We prioritize building lasting partnerships with our clients. We go beyond just delivering code, we proactively bring forward solutions for challenging problems. Whether in our team augmentation model or our project model, we are dedicated to our client's success.


We’re like no other outsourcing company. We create a great environment for our developers and ensure they want to stick around, rather than switch to our clients. We treat our developers with respect and provide a culture of learning and growth.


Rockstar, ninja, guru? No, thanks.

Friendly, hardworking, thoughtful? Yes, please.


If you are a manager of one, friendly, hardworking, thoughtful, and you care deeply about doing great work, then you'll do just fine here.


Role Description


We´re looking for a Backend Engineer to help design, build, and scale the core systems that power our client. You´ll work across data pipelines, API integrations, and service orchestration.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong English communication, writing and verbal.
  • 3–6 years of backend engineering experience in a SaaS or product-focused environment.
  • Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI, Flask, or similar).
  • Solid experience with SQL databases and RESTful API design.
  • Familiarity with A WS (Lambda, S3, ECS, or similar) and containerization (Docker).
  • Understanding of authentication, data security , and multi-tenant architecture principles.
  • Strong debugging, optimization, and problem-solving skills.


What We Offer


  • This will be a PJ hire with competitive pay in USD.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Supportive environment with 1-1 mentoring and group knowledge sharing sessions.
  • International experience working with leading startups in North America.


Bonus Qualifications


  • Experience integrating with CRMs or communication platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gmail, Slack).
  • Exposure to Databricks, event-driven systems, or streaming architectures.
  • Experience with modern CI/CD pipelines, Terraform, or Serverless Framework.

title: Senior React Native Developer
description:
Salary Open to negotitate based on experience, Competitive! (payment in USD)

(Full time position, independent contractor.)


StaffingAbroad is seeking a highly skilled Frontend Developer to join one of the #1 Fintech & Crypto companies in the United States . This is a unique opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and build world-class applications in a dynamic, innovative environment.

This position is offered as a 100% remote role.


About the Role

As a Frontend Developer, your primary skillset will be React Native , with additional strong experience in React being highly desirable. You’ll play a critical role in designing and delivering highly polished, pixel-perfect applications that provide exceptional user experiences. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and backend developers, to bring complex financial and crypto-related solutions to life.


What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software design, or related field of study, or equivalent experience.
  • 6+ years' experience building production-grade web or mobile applications with a strong focus on UI excellence.
  • English C1 (MUST)
  • Deep expertise with React Native (primary skill).
  • Strong experience with React (highly desirable), including hooks, context, and performance optimization.
  • Strong TypeScript experience.
  • Expert-level CSS skills with proficiency in Tailwind and styled-components .
  • Proven track record of delivering pixel-perfect, highly polished user interfaces .
  • Experience building and maintaining reusable component libraries .
  • Experience with complex form implementations and client-state management .
  • Solid foundation in software development best practices.
  • Familiarity with software quality practices such as unit testing, mocking, integration testing, and code coverage.
  • Experience using source control (Git) .
  • Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies .
  • Bilingual English (conversational level required) .
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Enthusiasm for working in a fast-paced, innovative environment and alignment with company culture and values.

Plus

  • Familiarity with Continuous Integration (CI/CD) pipelines (TeamCity, Azure DevOps).


Why Join?

  • 100% Remote –
  • Join a team that is shaping the future of #1 Fintech and Crypto in the U.S.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Job Title: VIP Account Manager

Location: Brazil -Remote


************ *Note - PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU HAVE IGAMING EXPERIENCE ******************


Our client, a well-known Brazilian gambling operator, is looking for a motivated VIP Account Manager to assist in managing and growing the VIP customer segment to help and assist the current VIP team in place.


This role will focus on building strong client relationships, supporting engagement strategies, and helping improve the overall VIP experience. It’s a great opportunity for someone with account management experience who wants to develop their skills in a dynamic industry.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Assist in identifying and onboarding new VIP clients through prospecting and networking.


  • Support the management of VIP client relationships, ensuring high levels of satisfaction.


  • Help execute engagement and retention strategies to increase player loyalty.


  • Work closely with senior team members to design and implement and improve VIP incentives, promotions, and personalized offers.


  • Monitor key performance metrics such as betting volume, customer acquisition cost (CAC), retention rates, and customer lifetime value (LTV).


  • Assist in preparing reports on VIP performance and account development.


  • Ensure compliance with responsible gaming and company policies.



Skills & Qualifications :


  • Experience in account management, sales, or customer service, preferably in the betting or online gaming industry.


  • A wallet or existing player base would be incredibly valuable and sought after.


  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills to build client relationships.


  • Basic knowledge of sports betting and online casino market is a plus.


  • Comfortable working with data and reports to understand customer behavior.


  • Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools.


  • Ability to work flexible hours when needed.


This role is ideal for someone eager to grow in VIP management, with the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals in the field and business.

title: SAP ECC ABAP
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços IT do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!


Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.


Procuramos SAP ABAP Consultant que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Temos alguns requisitos:


  • Fluência em inglês é mandatória para uma comunicação eficaz entre equipes globais e stakeholders.
  • Forte desenvolvimento ABAP em objetos RICEF: Relatórios (ALV), Interfaces (IDoc/BAPI/CPI-REST), Conversões (programas LTMC/LSMW/ABAP), Melhorias (BADI/Exits/Enh. Spots) e Formulários (SmartForms/Adobe).
  • ABAP orientado a objetos (OO), modularização, visualizações CDS, conceitos básicos de AMDP, desenvolvimento de serviços BOPF/Fiori OData; sólida depuração e ajuste de desempenho (SQL trace/ST05, SAT/SE30, análise de tempo de execução).
  • Experiência em todo o ciclo de vida: design técnico, construção, testes unitários, revisão de código, gerenciamento de transporte (ChaRM/SolMan) e resolução de defeitos em SIT/UAT/hipercare.
  • Sólido conhecimento de modelos de dados SD/MM/FI e pontos de integração; capacidade de traduzir especificações funcionais em soluções técnicas escaláveis e seguir padrões de codificação.



Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Entregar desenvolvimentos e integrações ABAP de alta qualidade, suportando módulos SAP e necessidades de localização;
  • Fornecer suporte e melhorias na produção.
  • Participar de workshops com equipes funcionais; criar Documentos de Design Técnico (TDD), estimativas e planos de construção.
  • Desenvolver e manter objetos RICEF em conformidade com os padrões de nomenclatura, desempenho e segurança; garantir a reutilização e o tratamento/registro de erros adequado.
  • Construir e expor interfaces via IDoc/BAPI/OData/REST; trabalhar com CPI/PI para mapeamentos de middleware e tratamento de erros.
  • Projetar saídas e formulários: SmartForms/Adobe (S/4 Output Management/BRFplus); lidar com código de barras/QR code e arquivamento em PDF.
  • Implementar melhorias via BADIs/Exits e eventos CDS/BOPF; criar frameworks de AIF/erro, trabalhos em segundo plano e controles de spool/impressão.
  • Realizar testes unitários, criar evidências de teste, oferecer suporte a SIT/UAT e resolver defeitos; manter a rastreabilidade em relação aos requisitos.
  • Otimizar o desempenho usando rastreamento SQL e análise de tempo de execução; Refatorar código personalizado para prontidão S/4HANA (Sintático/Funcional).
  • Gerenciar transportes entre ambientes; cumprir os padrões do Solution Manager/ChaRM e de documentação; oferecer suporte ao hypercare e ao KT para dar suporte às equipes.


O que oferecemos?


Benefícios TCS – Brasil:

  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – 0800 gratuito que fornece assistência psicológica (24 hrs/dia), jurídica, social e financeira aos associados
  • Parceria com SESC
  • Reembolso de Certificações
  • Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo
  • Oportunidade de experiência internacional
  • Parceria de Descontos com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas
  • Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação
  • TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance
  • Xcelerate – Plataforma de carreira com mentoria gratuita


Na TATA Consultancy Services promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, trabalhamos sempre pela equidade. Isso se aplica em Gênero, Pessoas com Deficiência, LGBTQIA+, Religião, Raça, Etnia, ou seja, todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com esses princípios. Pensamos em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social, a fim de construir uma TCS que respeita a individualidade. Seja um TCSer!

title: Sr Python Data Engineer
description:
Senior Python Data Engineer

About the Project


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain high-performance data processing pipelines using Python libraries (Pandas, Polars).
  • Develop and expose RESTful APIs using FastAPI or similar frameworks.
  • Consume and process normalized Parquet files from multiple upstream sources to generate dynamic Excel reports.
  • Contribute to a spec-driven development workflow (using GitHub Copilot, Claude, etc.) to scaffold and generate API/data pipeline code.
  • Optimize report generation logic for speed and scalability, currently targeting sub-20 second response times.
  • Integrate with messaging and storage mechanisms (e.g., Service Bus, Storage Accounts).
  • Collaborate on infrastructure-as-code automation using Bicep (or similar IaC tools).
  • Participate in design discussions for future migration to Snowflake and/or a data lake architecture.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.


Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong proficiency in Python for data processing (must have expertise in Pandas, nice to have: Polars, openpyxl).
  • Experience building backend services or APIs using frameworks like FastAPI.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling principles (Star Schema) and handling normalized datasets.
  • Familiarity with enterprise messaging patterns and data integration from various sources (API-based and file-based).
  • Experience working with GitHub and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar).
  • Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Bicep or comparable tools (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Comfort with spec-driven development and leveraging AI tools like GitHub Copilot for scaffolding.


Softensity is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are considered without regard to gender, identity, or personal background.

title: Fraud Risk Manager
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for a Fraud Risk Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on fraud prevention.

You'll act as the core fraud risk expert, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and design, implement, and oversee effective fraud controls across key local products.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Designing and enhancing fraud prevention controls within Brazil’s 1LoD framework, ensuring alignment with local BCB regulatory expectations and license requirements
  • Performing detailed fraud risk assessments across products (PIX, credit, cards, and business accounts), identifying control gaps and recommending practical mitigations
  • Leading the development and implementation of fraud prevention strategies, including creating and tuning transaction monitoring rules, leveraging data-driven models, and defining robust response workflows
  • Overseeing major fraud incidents and investigations, supporting containment, recovery, and required regulatory reporting processes
  • Partnering closely with Product and Data Science teams to improve automation, detection efficiency, and case triage logic, challenging the status quo for continuous improvement
  • Monitoring and analysing fraud trends and key performance indicators (KPIs) to produce actionable insights and dashboards for local management and committees
  • Strengthening fraud governance, ensuring clear documentation of risks, controls, and residual exposures to demonstrate control maturity during regulatory engagements


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in fraud risk management, prevention, detection, or Investigations within a financial institution or fintech
  • A deep understanding of fraud typologies, detection models, and control frameworks across payment and credit products (PIX, cards, credit)
  • Solid knowledge of local (BCB) FinCrime and fraud regulations and reporting obligations
  • Hands-on experience creating, tuning, and validating fraud detection rules and working with model performance metrics
  • Experience leading complex investigations end-to-end, identifying control weaknesses, and proposing remediation
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity, connect data to risk impact, and design pragmatic, scalable solutions
  • A proven ability to partner with Product, Data Science, and Compliance teams to implement risk controls effectively
  • Great communication skills to relay complex fraud and regulatory topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences


Nice to have


  • Proficiency in using analytical tools (e.g., SQL, Python, Looker)
  • Confidence in presenting risk insights, fraud trends, and remediation updates
  • An interest in developing junior team members as the function scales


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)


$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses


We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.


Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.


What You'll Actually Do


High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

title: SAP Mobile Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and maintain frontend application features for cross platform mobile SAP Service and Asset Manager.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of standard and SAP mobile technology in development and testing, such as SAP BTP Mobile Services, SAP Mobile Development Kit, JavaScript, TypeScript, Visual Studio Code, Xcode, Android Studio, ilodata, SQL, Ultralite DB, Appium, Java, SAP Business Application Studio, Github, CI/CD with Hyperspace Fastlane, OData Services, SAP Gateway, S/4HANA system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, feature requirement

Actively collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines for each platform, iOS, Android and Windows, and figma design for the application.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with backend integration service developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration in frontend logic

Use S/4HANA system and its relevant business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), and data objects (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), setup necessary test data in S/4HANA system, perform end-to-end test, and validate developed features against S/4HANA system.

Conduct thorough testing, including unit testing, integration test, and UI automation test scripts for developed features

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, crashes, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead MDK developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

O que Buscamos?


Arquiteto de sistemas .NET/Azure


Requisitos:


  • Experiência com desenvolvimento .NET Core/.NET Framework;
  • Experiência com DevOps;
  • Experiência com Microsoft Azure;
  • Experiência com Azure DevOps Services e Azure DevOps Server;
  • Certificações: AZ-204 e AZ-400;
  • Habilidades de apresentação técnica e voltada para o cliente com um alto grau de conforto com grandes e pequenos públicos;
  • Proficiência em arquitetura, desenvolvimento sistemas .Net Core e migração de soluções em nuvem;
  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para automatizar o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de desenvolvimento, QA e operações para otimizar processos e melhorar a eficiência;
  • Monitorar e manter a saúde, desempenho e segurança de nossa infraestrutura e aplicações;
  • Desenvolver e manter infraestrutura como código usando ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible ou similares;
  • Solucionar problemas e resolver questões relacionadas ao deployment de aplicações e infraestrutura;
  • Implementar e gerenciar tecnologias como Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Garantir a conformidade com as melhores práticas e políticas de segurança;
  • Inglês Avançado

Contratação CLT;

Convênio com Farmácia;

Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;

Gympass;

Seguro de Vida;

title: Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Python Data Engineer with an AI/ML focus to join our client’s growing data & analytics team in Brazil. This role is ideal for someone who loves building scalable data pipelines, operationalizing machine learning workflows, and partnering closely with data scientists to bring models into production.


You will design, develop, and maintain data infrastructure that powers AI-driven insights across the organization, including data models and pipelines that run through Snowflake . This is a fully remote position working with cross-functional product, engineering, and analytics teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build, optimize, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, modern data engineering frameworks, and Snowflake as a central data warehouse.
  • Architect and manage data workflows , ensuring accuracy, scalability, and reliability.
  • Work closely with data scientists to deploy, monitor, and tune machine learning models .
  • Develop feature engineering pipelines , preprocessing workflows, and model-serving APIs.
  • Integrate data from various sources (APIs, databases, cloud storage, streaming platforms).
  • Implement MLOps best practices including versioning, CI/CD for ML, and automated retraining workflows.
  • Optimize data storage, compute usage, and performance within Snowflake and cloud-native tools (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Create and maintain documentation, data catalogs, and operational guides.
  • Monitor data system performance and recommend improvements.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–7+ years of experience as a Data Engineer , Python Engineer , or similar backend/data role.
  • Strong proficiency in Python , including building production-grade data pipelines.
  • Experience with Snowflake —data modeling, Snowpipe, tasks, streams, stored procedures, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with AI/ML workflows : feature engineering, inference pipelines, or deploying models.
  • Proficiency in SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server).
  • Hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS , GCP , or Azure ).
  • Experience using data orchestration tools like Airflow , Prefect , or Dagster .
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI , or similar.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and distributed systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Spark , Databricks , or other big-data processing tools.
  • Experience ingesting and transforming data at scale on Snowflake , including optimization of virtual warehouses.
  • Familiarity with Kafka , Kinesis , or other streaming platforms.
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.).
  • Exposure to deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Experience working with Brazilian clients or LATAM distributed engineering teams.

title: College-Level Chemistry Tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.


Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.


Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.


We need tutors who can start immediately!


Characteristics


Payment in dollars.

Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.

Schedule: Flexible, free choice

Start: Immediate

Duration: Indefinite


Requirements


  • Ability to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
  • General Chemistry
  • Organic Chemistry
  • Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
  • Computer with an Internet connection.
  • No criminal record.


About LatinHire


Founded in 2003, LatinHire is a company specialising in managing teams of experts for distance learning institutions. Its clients include some of the world's most prestigious education startups.

title: Commercial Account Manager
description:
About WSO2:

Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) to thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of artificial intelligence and APIs for securely delivering the next generation of AI-enabled digital services and applications. Our open source, AI-driven, API-first approach frees developers and architects from vendor lock-in and enables rapid digital product creation. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has more than 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with over USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

The Commercial Account Executive is responsible for managing and growing existing customer accounts and leveraging new business opportunities. This role requires a strong understanding of customer needs, complex sales projects, the ability to build and maintain long-term relationships, and a proven track record of exceeding sales targets.

Key Responsibilities:

Account Management:

  • Develop and execute account plans to achieve revenue growth and customer satisfaction goals.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers at existing customer accounts. Ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Proactively identify and pursue new business opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Conduct regular account reviews and provide insightful business reviews to customers.
  • Work closely with other departments (including pre-sales, product, legal, and marketing) to support customer success.

Sales and Revenue:

  • Achieve and exceed assigned sales quotas and revenue targets.

title: Consultor(a) Microsoft Dynamics + PowerPlatform Sênior
description:
A Inetum é uma empresa líder global em serviços de TI, dedicada a fornecer soluções inovadoras aos nossos clientes. Estamos comprometidos em promover um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, inclusivo e que preza pela diversidade, onde a criatividade e a colaboração prosperem. Estamos presentes em 19 países e somos mais de 28.000 colaboradores no mundo.


Procuramos um consultor sênior experiente em Dynamics 365 para apoiar o desenvolvimento, aprimoramento e otimização de um ambiente Microsoft Dynamics 365. Essa função envolve trabalhar em casos complexos, projetando e configurando soluções nos módulos Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service e Customer Insights: Journeys, além de utilizar os recursos do Power Platform para automatizar processos de negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Configurar e personalizar os módulos Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service e Customer Insights: Journeys.
  • Projetar e implementar soluções usando Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse).
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações dual-write com Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
  • Apoiar migrações de dados e garantir integridade, escalabilidade e conformidade do sistema.
  • Documentar o trabalho no Jira e Confluence em um ambiente ágil.
  • Entregar soluções de alta qualidade com atenção aos detalhes e à experiência do usuário.


Qualificações

  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência prática com Dynamics 365 CE (Sales, Customer Service, Customer Insights: Journeys).
  • Forte conhecimento em configuração, personalização e design de soluções.
  • Compreensão sólida das capacidades da Power Platform.
  • Experiência com integrações (baseadas em API e dual-write) e migração de dados.
  • Familiaridade com entrega ágil e ferramentas como Jira e Confluence.
  • Certificações Microsoft relevantes para consultores sêniores de D365.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar com equipes distribuídas.
  • Experiência em consultoria ou ambientes de entrega baseados em projetos.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente.


Informações Adicionais

Horário de trabalho: 6h às 15h (fuso horário da Europa).

Alocação: Superior a 6 meses.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Backend - Pleno (Golang)
description:
O seu papel como Software Engineer Pleno (E2)

  • Desenvolver programação do início ao fim, incluindo definições de arquitetura, testes e rollout em produção;
  • Desenvolvimento de projetos com arquitetura de microserviços, consumo e geração de eventos em Streaming, API's;
  • Garantir a funcionalidade, manutenibilidade e velocidade, além de práticas de teste e qualidade;
  • Garantir que todas as soluções técnicas estejam alinhadas a estratégia do negócio e entender iniciativas relacionadas ao produto;
  • Ajudar o time no desenho de soluções com arquitetura evolutiva, além de investigar constantemente novas tecnologias e formas de trabalho;
  • Colaborar com a evolução das habilidades técnicas do time e esforços de melhoria contínua que impactam vários times;
  • Trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo, em que práticas de pareamento, feedbacks e motivação para se desenvolver são comuns a todos os squads.


O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo:

  • Conhecimento avançado em desenvolvimento em Golang ou Typescript ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de consumidores e produtores de eventos para Event Streaming (Kafka) ;
  • Conhecimento em Docker & Kubernetes ;
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade ;
  • Conhecimento sobre testes unitários e de integração;
  • Preocupação com a qualidade e desempenho das soluções propostas;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente multifuncional e colaborativo;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento e implementação de APIs ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de microsserviços distribuídos ;
  • Embasamento teórico, habilidade e preocupação com a excelência técnica e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (DDD, Arquitetura, Design de Código, Paradigmas, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.


Seria legal se você conhecesse:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento em C# ;
  • Google Cloud Continuous Integration;
  • Continuous Delivery.

title: Consultor Funcional Tax One
description:
Muito prazer, Somos a Evertec!

A Evertec é uma empresa especializada em tecnologia para o setor financeiro, com mais de 27 anos de atuação e presença em 26 países da América Latina e Caribe. Com mais de 11 bilhões de transações processadas anualmente, somos referência em soluções que impulsionam a transformação digital do mercado.

Oferecemos um portfólio completo de soluções em software, atendendo instituições financeiras, empresas e fintechs que buscam inovação, segurança e eficiência.

Nosso compromisso é com a excelência tecnológica, a inclusão financeira e a geração de valor sustentável para clientes, colaboradores e parceiros, promovendo um ecossistema mais conectado e acessível.


Requisitos

  • Conhecimento e experiência com a solução Tax One.
  • Vivência em gestão de backlog e práticas ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experiência na criação e gestão de tickets (definição de regra e municípios).
  • Conhecimento em processos fiscais e legislação tributária.
